description: This file defines interfaces and related types for implementing reminder functionality in Orleans grains, including the IRemindable interface, the IGrainReminder interface, the TickStatus struct, and the ReminderException class.

classes.name: TickStatus
classes.description: Immutable struct representing the status of a reminder tick, including timing information.

classes.name: ReminderException
classes.description: Exception class for errors related to Orleans Reminder functions or services.

methods.name: ReceiveReminder
methods.description: Method invoked to deliver a reminder to a grain implementing IRemindable.

methods.name: TickStatus (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the TickStatus struct with timing details.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the TickStatus instance.

methods.name: ReminderException (constructor)
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the ReminderException with a message.
